value.signature: fn run_stdout_json_command_from_origin_inner < Context , Output , CommandError , Hook , Prepare , Install , Load , EmitControl , EmitOutput , Run , Tty , > (command_name : & str , hook : Hook , prepare : Prepare , tty : Tty , install : Install , load : Load , mut emit_control : EmitControl , mut emit_output : EmitOutput , run : Run ,) -> ExitCode where Output : serde :: Serialize , CommandError : std :: fmt :: Display , Hook : FnOnce () , Prepare : FnOnce () -> OriginPreparation < Context > , Install : FnOnce (serde_json :: Value) -> Result < Option < observation :: OriginInstallation > , observation :: BootstrapError > , Load : FnOnce () , EmitControl : FnMut (& ControlPlaneRecord) -> io :: Result < () > , EmitOutput : FnMut (& Output) -> io :: Result < () > , Run : FnOnce (Context) -> Result < Output , CommandError > , Tty : FnOnce () -> Option < ControlPlaneRecord > ,

exception.justification: Justified: This entry-origin adapter selects a bounded pre-installation path and hands it to the explicit command root without starting a second operation.

review.body: { hook () ; let prepared = prepare () ; let prepared = match prepared { OriginPreparation :: Continue { context , arguments } => { if let Some (record) = tty () { OriginPreparation :: Terminal { exit : CliExit :: new (record , CommandExit :: Usage) , arguments , } } else { OriginPreparation :: Continue { context , arguments } } } terminal @ OriginPreparation :: Terminal { .. } => terminal , } ; let arguments = match & prepared { OriginPreparation :: Continue { arguments , .. } | OriginPreparation :: Terminal { arguments , .. } => arguments . clone () , } ; let mut installation = match install (arguments) { Ok (installation) => installation , Err (error @ observation :: BootstrapError :: Configuration (_)) => { let mut record = ControlPlaneRecord :: usage_error (command_name , "observation_configuration") ; record . message = error . to_string () ; let _ignored = emit_control (& record) ; return CommandExit :: Usage . exit_code () ; } Err (observation :: BootstrapError :: Unavailable (_)) => None , } ; let root = installation . as_mut () . map (| handle | { handle . take_root () . unwrap_or_else (| _ | unreachable ! ("new origin installation retains its root")) }) ; let scope = root . as_ref () . map (| lease | lease . enter_command_scope (command_name)) ; load () ; let (exit , outcome , result) = match prepared { OriginPreparation :: Terminal { exit , .. } => { let emitted = emit_control (& exit . record) ; if emitted . is_err () && exit . exit == CommandExit :: Success { tracing :: error ! ("failed to write JSON result to stdout") ; (CommandExit :: Failure . exit_code () , observation :: Outcome :: Error , serde_json :: json ! ({ "error" : "failed to write JSON result to stdout" }) ,) } else { let result = serde_json :: json ! ({ "record" : exit . record , "exit" : exit . exit }) ; let outcome = if exit . exit == CommandExit :: Success { observation :: Outcome :: Success } else if exit . exit == CommandExit :: Usage { observation :: Outcome :: Refusal } else { observation :: Outcome :: Error } ; (exit . exit . exit_code () , outcome , result) } } OriginPreparation :: Continue { context , .. } => match run (context) { Ok (output) => match emit_output (& output) { Ok (()) => (CommandExit :: Success . exit_code () , observation :: Outcome :: Success , serde_json :: to_value (& output) . unwrap_or (serde_json :: Value :: Null) ,) , Err (error) => { tracing :: error ! (error = % error , "failed to write JSON to stdout") ; (CommandExit :: Failure . exit_code () , observation :: Outcome :: Error , serde_json :: json ! ({ "error" : error . to_string () }) ,) } } , Err (error) => { tracing :: error ! (error = % error , "command failed") ; (CommandExit :: Failure . exit_code () , observation :: Outcome :: Error , serde_json :: json ! ({ "error" : error . to_string () }) ,) } } , } ; if let Some (root) = root { root . finish (outcome , result) ; } drop (scope) ; drop (installation) ; exit }
review.item_premise: The inner runner selects failure and attempts its terminal ERROR before root completion and installation drop when a selected result cannot be written.
